platforms.summary: The hosted Harness Hub connects Google accounts to owned and invited projects.

configuration.name: Public origin
configuration.description: An exact HTTPS origin for the target environment; the checked-in value is localhost.

configuration.name: Session database
configuration.description: The checked-in database ID is a placeholder. Apply db/migrations to the target database.

configuration.name: Session secret
configuration.description: Set through the host secret store.

requirements: Register dedicated Cloudflare Pages, D1 and R2 resources; replace local resource placeholders.
Register a dedicated Google web client and GitHub App for the target origin and environment.
Set the named credentials in the host secret store and apply the database migrations.
Configure the relay Worker binding if phone access to remote hosts is enabled.

platforms.summary: The iOS shell uses the bundled renderer. Simulator builds exist; device distribution needs signing configuration.

configuration.name: Hub origin
configuration.description: Public Xcode build setting: the exact HTTPS Hub origin for shared accounts.

configuration.name: Device signing
configuration.description: Simulator products use ad-hoc signing. A device release requires a signing team and provisioning.

requirements: Configure the intended Apple signing team and device provisioning before a physical-device release.
Set the public Hub origin for the intended environment and archive through Xcode for distribution.

platforms.summary: This repository has no native Android project, Android Capacitor dependency or Android build command.
requirements: Add the Android native platform and its application identifier.
Configure release signing, the distribution destination and an Android build command.

platforms.summary: The desktop workspace builds the shared renderer and Electron main/preload bundles, with a macOS app packaging target.

configuration.name: Hub origin
configuration.description: The exact trusted HTTPS Hub origin, set in the desktop host environment.

configuration.name: Code signing
configuration.description: Optional exact certificate SHA-1 fingerprint. Packaging signs ad hoc when unset.

requirements: Run the macOS packaging target on a Mac.
Configure the intended distribution certificate and notarization process before distributing a public macOS release.
Windows and Linux packaging targets are not configured in this repository.
